title: ZXTank Support
description: Find ZXTank support, diagnostic-information and in-development guidance from BarkinMad Studios.
summary: ZXTank is still in development, so support information will grow alongside the release build.
heroImageAlt: BarkinMad Studios placeholder artwork while ZXTank support information is prepared

sections.heading: Support During Development
paragraphs: ZXTank is currently in development. Features, presentation and availability may change before release.
Release troubleshooting, audio and control guidance will be published only after the relevant features have been verified.

sections.heading: Basic Troubleshooting
paragraphs: When a release build is available, first check that you are using the latest version, restart the app and restart your device before reporting a problem.
If an Apple Game Center feature is included in the release, confirm that you are signed in to Game Center and try again after checking your connection.

sections.heading: Contact Support
paragraphs: Use the [BarkinMad Studios contact page](/contact) to report a problem or ask a question.

Please include the ZXTank version, device model, iOS version, what happened, when it happened and any relevant screenshots. Do not include passwords, account credentials or other sensitive information.

sections.heading: Privacy and Consent
paragraphs: Privacy and consent-reset instructions will be published after the release advertising and consent configuration has been verified.
Read the current [ZXTank Privacy Information](/apps/zxtank/privacy) for development-stage service information.
